QuestInfo.name: [Black Wings] Secret Proposition
QuestInfo.0: You try to enter the mine, but are stopped by the gatekeepers. You must be a member of the Black Wings and have permission to enter. Just when you think there's no other way, someone offers you a proposition...
QuestInfo.1: You try to enter the Mine, but are stopped by the gatekeepers. You must be a member of the Black Wings and have permission to enter. Just when you think there's no other way, #p2153000# says he has a proposition for you. Talk to #b#p2153000##k.
QuestInfo.2: #p2153000# looks like he's a Black Wing watchman. You wonder what kind secret proposition he could have in mind...

0.0: What are you doing here, bumpkin? There are to be no civilian trespassers near the mines while the Black Wings work. Go back to the city before I report you to my superiors. Unless...
0.1: You seem the type to be loose with a coin purse. I could be persuaded to be so loose with my tongue, for a price. Come speak to me in secret if you're interested in making a deal...

no.0: I won't force you. If there is another way, you're more than welcome to try it. IF there is another way...

1.0: All right. I'll tell you. It's really not as hard as you think.
